status: generation, frozen before external prior-art search

candidates.what: Atomic propositions: subject, relation, object, quantifiers, polarity and source-field span
candidates.function: Grade each conjunct independently instead of promoting a whole field
candidates.reader: evidence.mjs would need a claim-id lookup; current audit can display spans
candidates.receipt: A window stating the complete proposition, or a pinned theorem plus reviewed interpretation
candidates.cost: 2 to 8 rows per entry; high semantic review; unsplit compounds remain unchecked
candidates.departure: Replace a field-wide grade with proposition-local grades
candidates.kill: Splits do not improve disagreement detection

candidates.what: Hypotheses as scoped typed predicates with bound variables and explicit obligations
candidates.function: Reject a route whose required assumptions are false, and report unknown ones
candidates.reader: compose.mjs needs an obligation environment; Formalization reads unresolved goals
candidates.receipt: Receipt every predicate and its scope in a complete theorem or stated source rule
candidates.cost: 1 to 6 obligations per claim; a small decidable fragment is checkable; no automatic corpus backfill
candidates.departure: Treat conditions as goals rather than longer prose
candidates.kill: Predicates cannot bind actual operands or fail closed

candidates.what: Operand roles, identity and lifetime: named joint inputs, outputs and persistent context
candidates.function: Carry the same principal, curve or authority through a route
candidates.reader: compose.mjs requires a named environment; Phone freeze is first case
candidates.receipt: Pinned contract and binding statement for each role; equality witness for aliasing
candidates.cost: 2 to 5 roles per operation; syntactic joins cheap; identity evidence adds debt
candidates.departure: A join unifies variables rather than matching only carriers
candidates.kill: Variable binding silently supplies an absent authority

candidates.what: Entry nature and shape: operation, theorem, algorithm, relation; partial, stochastic, dependent, multivalued
candidates.function: Prevent retrieval or composition treating an existence theorem as a function
candidates.reader: MCP search needs nature filters; compose must reject unsupported shapes
candidates.receipt: Receipt a defining statement that identifies the shape, separate from the legacy kind
candidates.cost: One record per reviewed home; easy syntax, moderate classification debt
candidates.departure: Distinguish what an entry is from how its name sounds
candidates.kill: Classifications do not change a consumer decision

candidates.what: Quantities: parameter dependencies, dimensions, bounds, probabilities and asymptotic regimes
candidates.function: Check that a numerical guarantee fits requested accuracy, dimension and failure budget
candidates.reader: MCP problem query and compose would need quantity constraints
candidates.receipt: Quote the complete bound with hypotheses, constants/conventions and probability space
candidates.cost: 1 to 4 bound rows per relevant claim; algebra partly decidable; many theorem-specific gaps
candidates.departure: A bound is a dependent claim, not complexity text
candidates.kill: Units or asymptotics cannot be compared honestly

candidates.what: Worked instances: exact inputs, outputs, intermediate steps and boundary cases
candidates.function: Teach and replay an operation, and expose convention mismatches
candidates.reader: MCP get_entry can display; a disposable evaluator executes fixtures
candidates.receipt: Source example plus exact recomputation, with invented test inputs labeled
candidates.cost: 3 to 10 instances per selected entry; finite evaluation cheap; universal claims remain unchecked
candidates.departure: Examples become reproducible fixtures
candidates.kill: Examples are mistaken for universal proofs

candidates.what: Mathematical standing: proved, conjectured, conditional, refuted, independent, folklore
candidates.function: Separate unsettled mathematics from an unchecked map description
candidates.reader: MCP display and Formalization queue need this separate axis
candidates.receipt: Dated primary statement, named conditions and foundation; revisions stay visible
candidates.cost: One or more time-indexed rows per claim; ongoing review; folklore remains weak
candidates.departure: Keep truth status separate from receipt coverage
candidates.kill: A single theorem label collapses disputed scope

candidates.what: Foundational profile: axioms, universe, constructivity, choice and computational content
candidates.function: Block transport into a foundation that cannot admit its assumptions
candidates.reader: lean.mjs and external-proof adapter need axiom-set comparison
candidates.receipt: Kernel axiom audit at a pin plus statement-fidelity review
candidates.cost: One audit per proof artifact; mechanical extraction, semantic alignment debt
candidates.departure: Foundations become inputs to transport
candidates.kill: An audit is treated as proof of intended meaning

candidates.what: Parameterized families and degenerations: parameter type, regular range and limiting object
candidates.function: Find nearby operations and distinguish a limit from an equivalence
candidates.reader: deform.mjs can consume a family adapter; MCP can browse
candidates.receipt: Source formula and range; certificate or computed limiting identity
candidates.cost: One family plus member links; symbolic limits mixed; many new unchecked limits
candidates.departure: Store the singular boundary explicitly
candidates.kill: Limit transport silently preserves structure it loses

candidates.what: Conventions: normalization, sign, orientation, indexing, base ring and notation binding

candidates.receipt: Quote definitions on both sides and the explicit conversion
candidates.cost: One profile per representation and arrows between profiles; cheap finite checks
candidates.departure: Conventions are typed parameters, not footnotes
candidates.kill: Profile does not determine the conversion

candidates.what: Operator laws: linearity, monotonicity, idempotence, continuity, functoriality

candidates.what: Specialization/generalization: premise implication and parameter substitution
